page.overview:
Who is Exalting Blade of Favor?

The is a plus six legendary, sentient sword that allows its wielder to resist fire and lightning damage and upon purchase deals 1d10 plus five radiant damage. As Capo walked down a dark pathway, he wished that the sword would begin to emit light, which it promptly accomplished.

The Exalting Blade of Favor has gold and silver inlay with an intricate hilt. When worn in combination with the Crimson Sphere of Generosity, its surge of generosity is doubled.

In the distant past, the sword was wielded by a great hero, Shiona, who defeated Zathkira the Mad but vanished in his underground laboratory, along with his sword.
